message.content:
I'll search for information about altavista.com.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>altavista.com history what happened to AltaVista search engine</query>

Based on my search, here's information about **altavista.com**:

AltaVista was one of the **first major search engines** on the web, launched in **1995** by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC). It was groundbreaking for its time, offering:

- One of the first searchable full-text databases of a large portion of the World Wide Web
- The ability to search for phrases and use Boolean operators
- Fast search speeds that were impressive for the mid-1990s

**What happened to AltaVista:**

- **1998**: Acquired by Compaq when Compaq bought DEC
- **1999**: Sold to CMGI
- **2003**: Acquired by **Overture Services** (formerly GoTo.com)
- **2003**: Yahoo! acquired Overture Services, bringing AltaVista under Yahoo's ownership
- **2011**: Yahoo! began redirecting AltaVista queries to Yahoo Search
- **July 8, 2013**: Yahoo! **officially shut down** AltaVista

The domain **altavista.com** now redirects to Yahoo's search page or may no longer resolve to an active service. AltaVista is remembered as a pioneer that helped shape modern web search, though it ultimately couldn't compete with Google's rise to dominance in the early 2000s.

Sources:
1. https://www.britannica.com/topic/AltaVista
2. https://www.searchenginejournal.com/alta-vista/302709/
3. https://www.theverge.com/2013/6/28/4472508/yahoo-kills-alta-vista-search-engine
4. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AltaVista
